title: eat shit & die 173
author: bpatrick
html: I may have gone too far with this one – but I think it’s funny so here it is. This actually usually happens to me (although not to this extreme) with a girlfriend/girl friend in the loud-mouth role but that situation precludes the punch line here and ends with me looking like a coward while secretly siding with our adversaries.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.html:
Dude, this is great. Totally a standout, in fact (best comeuppance ever, too). This is like Classic Akimbo; there’s no other webcomic that would do something like this, so good on yer.
(this one deserves some better jpeg compression, incidentally. Are you able to adjust that at all in whatever program you’re using? Sorry, i just always notice stuff like that, i don’t mean to distract from what is an amazing comic!)

comments.author: David
comments.html: This is awesome, and yes, classic Akimbo. Not too far, either, not that I’d mind if it were.

comments.author: ivegotafloor
comments.html: Man, this if FUCKING BRILLIANT. Love it.

comments.author: Soe
comments.html: Haha! Genius! I actually felt the awkwardness and frustration!

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.html: Even though I (often poorly) admin the site, I have nothing to do with the art or comics (except the one-off “Line Tool”) Have to say, this comic is fucking great. Well done.

comments.author: msr
comments.html: I love it. Stand up to the ignorant cunt next time, though 🙂

comments.author: LoudPrint
comments.html: “Have to say, this comic is fucking great.” It can’t be said a better way.
